moz-acme-tile-frame.description: Tile chrome frame: header, browser slot, resize grip, states, gestures

moz-acme-workspace-preview.description: Store-only workspace wireframe preview beside the switcher (hover/focus feedback)

moz-acme-shared.description: Shared widget substrate: MozAcmeElement base (Fluent wiring + emitIntent) + menu roving + the list-drag machine

moz-acme-editor.description: The Editor tile (contracts/editor.md): vendored the editor 6 (a pinned vendor drop) orchestrator + lazy directory tree in shadow DOM — components emit (open/save/close/doc-changed intents), the chrome controller owns every filesystem touch and storage commit

moz-acme-pane-stack.description: The split pane stack: the active pane's favicon in front of its partner's inside one favicon's box; the rear is a fixed swap target whose hit area is the half nearer to it, a side change plays the swap

moz-acme-dock.description: Bottom-centre canvas dock: chips over tabOrder (fly / dive / reorder / close)

validationExceptions.reason: the vendored the editor bundle's character-width probe
pointer-only rear inside a tab or a switcher card, whose host owns the keyboard
deliberate no-delegatesFocus: the host is its own tab stop for the two-step focus model, distinct from the header controls and the move and resize affordances
moz-acme-shared has no element of its own: its modules are template parts, and the refine bar
